official.deadline_note: There is no public application deadline. The Advice Center for Study Funding identifies enrolled students with an outstanding academic performance in the HSG Assessment Year and invites them to apply; an application without an invitation is not possible. The 1 October and 1 March dates published on the same page apply to partial or total remission of tuition fees, not to Excellence Scholarships.
official.status_note: Not open to self-application: enrolled students of the University of St.Gallen with an outstanding academic performance in the HSG Assessment Year are identified by the Advice Center for Study Funding and invited to apply, and an application without an invitation is not possible.

applicant_utility.summary: This award cannot be applied for. The Advice Center for Study Funding screens enrolled students on their HSG Assessment Year performance and issues invitations, so the only realistic route is to perform strongly in that Assessment Year rather than to watch for an application window. The value is defined indirectly: it equals the current Bachelor-level tuition fee for six semesters, which makes it a full tuition waiver rather than a stipend, and the University of St.Gallen funds it jointly with the Monique Dornonville de la Cour - Stiftung in cooperation with the Advice Center. Because the amount tracks the fee in force at the time of award rather than a fixed sum, its monetary value moves with St.Gallen's fee schedule, and the official page publishes no figure you can plan a budget against.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Already-enrolled St.Gallen Bachelor's students who rank at the top of their HSG Assessment Year cohort; there is nothing here for external applicants.
application_readiness_checklist: Focus effort on the HSG Assessment Year, because that performance is what surfaces your name to the Advice Center for Study Funding
If invited, respond quickly and complete the application form together with every enclosure the funding source requires
Ask the Advice Center for Study Funding directly which enclosures apply to your funding source, since the page does not list them
Do not rely on the 1 October and 1 March dates published on the same page; those govern tuition-fee remission applications, not this scholarship
Track your six semesters of eligibility, since the award covers Bachelor tuition for three years rather than a single year
common_rejection_risks: Waiting for a public call for applications that will never come, because the award is by invitation only
Assuming the tuition-fee remission deadlines apply, and submitting a remission form instead of responding to a scholarship invitation
Overlooking that additional selection criteria can be attached depending on the funding source, so a strong transcript is not automatically sufficient
Assuming the award includes any living-cost or travel support, which the page does not state
Confusing this with the Master's-level HSG Best Talents Programme, which is restricted to EU and EFTA nationals and Swiss C permit holders
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Living costs and travel are not covered; the award covers Bachelor-level tuition fees for six semesters only, so you must fund your own cost of living in St.Gallen for the full three years.
document_audit: The required enclosures are defined by the funding source rather than published centrally, so the invitation itself is the authoritative document list
The University states that applications require more than the form alone, so leave time to assemble the supporting material
Selection sits with the relevant committees in cooperation with the funding foundation, so there is no single decision-maker to query about timing
alerts: There is no public deadline and no external application route, so any listing that implies you can apply directly is misleading
Additional selection criteria may be applied depending on the funding source, so meeting the Assessment Year threshold is a gateway rather than a guarantee
The University also cooperates with the Swiss Study Foundation and the German Academic Scholarship Foundation on a similar invitation basis, so an invitation to one does not exclude the others
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: The Advice Center for Study Funding identifies enrolled students with outstanding HSG Assessment Year performance and invites them to apply; invited students complete the application form with its enclosures, and the relevant committees decide in cooperation with the funding foundation.
